title: Installation
subtitle: Get started with qortex-react
description: Install qortex-react for your React application.
content: Install qortex-react using your preferred package manager. Note that qortex-react includes all qortex-core functionalities.

sections.title: Install Package
sections.content: Add the package to your React project:

code.code:
# npm
npm install qortex-react

# yarn
yarn add qortex-react

# pnpm
pnpm add qortex-react
